event.data_license_status: USFS Research Data Archive says the data may be used without additional permissions or fees; cite Short (2026), DOI 10.2737/RDS-2013-0009.7. Check licenses separately for any joined raster or perimeter products.

discovery_time.precision: reported calendar date and HHMM; source timezone is not assigned by this adapter

location_wgs84.accuracy_note: Point geometry requested from the current USFS service in EPSG:4326. The publication's stated minimum location precision is a PLSS section (one-square-mile grid); event-specific accuracy is not provided here.

seed_cell_selection.note: Starting cell is selected from the pre-event FBFM13 map only. If the reported cell is non-burnable, the closest burnable cell within half a PLSS section is used as an uncertain proxy; this does not claim a verified ignition location.

fire_behavior.weather_mapping_note: Mapped from per-case gridMET daily context using the explicit v1 proxy in weather_mapping. It is a stationary representative-day assumption, not an hourly event replay or measured midflame weather.

grid.resolution_note: Exact 30 m projected cells in the event's UTM zone; the reported point is assigned to its containing cell and remains spatially uncertain.

fuel.units_and_mapping: 30 m nearest-neighbor sample from pre-event LF2022 FBFM13. Native codes must pass the pinned SimFire operational fuel mapping before case promotion.

terrain.units_and_mapping: Source meters; nearest-neighbor aligned to the 30 m UTM grid; SimFire converts meters to feet.

weather.source: gridMET daily point values via NCAR GDEX
weather.source_release: gridMET Daily Surface Data; GDEX dataset d761426
weather.units_and_mapping: Original daily gridMET context; see fire_behavior.weather_mapping for the separate approximate SimFire proxy and its assumptions.

limitations: FPA-FOD point has unknown event-specific precision and represents an incident reference, not verified GPS ignition.
The cohort is screened to >=5000 reported acres and ten western states; it is not a representative sample of all fires.
FPA-reported final area is post-response context only and is not used as a no-action target or agent reward.
gridMET provides daily approximately 4-km context; its separate SimFire proxy is assumption-based and is not an hourly replay or measured fuel moisture.
A source-compatible fuel raster is pre-event but is not a field-verified vegetation survey for the event date.

references.notes: MTBS_ID=ID4470311374220230719 is a separate observed-perimeter reference for later visual context only. Neither MTBS perimeters nor FPA final size are agent input or reward. Simulation start is selected by the pre-event fuel-only rule recorded in fire_behavior.seed_cell_selection; it does not use observed burn perimeters.
